name: mailgun
description: Send, route, and analyze email through Mailgun's transactional email platform via the official mailgun-mcp-server. Send transactional mail, manage domains, mailing lists, templates, webhooks, and inbound routes, query deliverability statistics, and review suppressions and dedicated IP pools.

interface.shortDescription: Send transactional email and manage deliverability through the official Mailgun MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Mailgun skill exposes the official `mailgun-mcp-server` (`@mailgun/mcp-server`, Apache 2.0) as a single Fractal toolset. It gives the agent a workflow-oriented interface for sending transactional email, retrieving and resending stored messages, verifying domain DNS, managing click / open / unsubscribe tracking, creating and updating event webhooks and inbound routes, managing mailing lists and members, authoring versioned email templates, querying per-message logs and aggregate sending statistics (by domain, tag, provider, device, country), reviewing bounces / unsubscribes / complaints / allowlist entries, classifying bounces, and inspecting dedicated IP pool configuration. The server authenticates with a `MAILGUN_API_KEY` environment variable that is read by the local server process only and is never exposed to the model. By default every product tag (`send`, `validate`, `optimize`, `inspect`) is registered; pass `--tags <list>` or set `MAILGUN_MCP_TAGS` to scope the toolset to a subset. The server exposes no delete operations by design, which limits the blast radius of prompt-injection-driven mutations.
defaultPrompt: Use the Mailgun skill whenever the task involves sending transactional email, checking deliverability, managing domains, mailing lists, templates, webhooks, or inbound routes, or reviewing bounces, unsubscribes, and complaints.
Verify the sending domain (SPF / DKIM / MX) with the domain-verification tool before sending any production email.
Match `MAILGUN_API_REGION` (`us` or `eu`) to the region of the API key, and scope the toolset with `--tags` or `MAILGUN_MCP_TAGS` when the workflow only needs a subset of capability groups.
